parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for human Aromatase (CHEMBL1978) with canonical SMILES and PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures (INNER JOIN for structures). Filter by target CHEMBL1978, standard_type IC50, and presence of canonical_smiles and (pubmed_id OR doi). Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
